scope: Studio generation control is a current-production surface. When a frozen pack exists it still reads lighting/costume only from renderedPrompt overlay lines (unit-grid requires panelId). When the pack is missing it falls back to lock-version sceneLighting/costumeState via getStudioUnitLockOverlays (readOnly SQL, cap 6). Scene backrefs always use current-head getStudioSceneBackReferences; click-through selects the exact unit/panel and fail-closes instead of guessing panels[0]. Does not change StudioDashboardPanelSummary, get_studio_trace, Binding inspect, or dispatch.
